name: building-blocks-text-primitives
title: Text Primitives
description: Small Tailwind text atoms for labels, headings, helper copy, metrics, and concise value lines.
useWhen: Small Tailwind text atoms for labels, headings, helper copy, metrics, and concise value lines.
avoidWhen: Avoid text primitives when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Text Primitives uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
